note: 数据级/结构重建迁移：两版执行**同一份**清单。when=null 表示无条件执行（语句自身幂等）；kind=rows 的 sql 是只读 SELECT，返回 ≥1 行才执行；kind=index_origin_unique 表示表上存在 UNIQUE 约束索引才执行。handler 需宿主语言实现（未知 handler 必须报错退出，不得静默跳过）。

guards.rows: SELECT 返回 ≥1 行才执行该步
guards.index_origin_unique: PRAGMA index_list(表) 里存在 origin='u' 的索引才执行

handlers.projects_guide_text_merge: 废弃列 commit_spec/deploy_spec 的内容并入 guide_text 后清空两列
handlers.projects_work_dir_from_legacy_cases_root: 工作目录化：旧 work_dir（案例库根）改存工作目录，bug_dir 列废弃置空
handlers.feishu_appsettings_bridge: 飞书配置用户级化：旧全局 app_settings['feishu'] 迁给 admin 的用户级配置

steps.desc: 废弃列 commit_spec/deploy_spec 的内容并入 guide_text 后清空两列

when.sql: SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE trim(coalesce(commit_spec,'')) != '' OR trim(coalesce(deploy_spec,'')) != '' LIMIT 1

steps.desc: 多用户隔离：存量项目（user_id=0）归 admin

when.sql: SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE user_id=0 LIMIT 1

sql: UPDATE projects SET user_id= COALESCE((SELECT id FROM users WHERE username='admin'), 0) WHERE user_id=0

steps.desc: 阻塞让行提交退场：清理存量卡片上的机器文案 block_text

when.sql: SELECT 1 FROM board_cards WHERE block_text LIKE '提交中：%' OR block_text LIKE '提交失败：%' LIMIT 1

sql: UPDATE board_cards SET block_text='' WHERE block_text LIKE '提交中：%' OR block_text LIKE '提交失败：%'

steps.desc: 阻塞让行提交退场：清理存量卡片上的提交失败 last_error

when.sql: SELECT 1 FROM board_cards WHERE last_error LIKE '阻塞让行提交失败%' OR last_error LIKE '阻塞让行提交异常%' LIMIT 1

sql: UPDATE board_cards SET last_error='', last_error_at=NULL WHERE last_error LIKE '阻塞让行提交失败%'    OR last_error LIKE '阻塞让行提交异常%'

steps.desc: 权限档改存 DSH 宿主 preset：旧三档 manual/yolo/auto 归一（manual→workspace-write，yolo/auto→danger-full-access），此后 permission_mode 只存宿主 preset key 或空串

when.sql: SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE permission_mode IN ('manual','yolo','auto') LIMIT 1

sql: UPDATE projects SET permission_mode='workspace-write' WHERE permission_mode='manual'
UPDATE projects SET permission_mode='danger-full-access' WHERE permission_mode IN ('yolo','auto')

steps.desc: 任务会话权限档改存 DSH 宿主 preset：旧三档 manual/yolo/auto 归一（manual→workspace-write，yolo/auto→danger-full-access）

when.sql: SELECT 1 FROM tasks WHERE permission IN ('manual','yolo','auto') LIMIT 1

sql: UPDATE tasks SET permission='workspace-write' WHERE permission='manual'
UPDATE tasks SET permission='danger-full-access' WHERE permission IN ('yolo','auto')

steps.desc: 旧库 projects.name 全局 UNIQUE → (user_id,name) 用户内唯一：重建表
sql: ALTER TABLE projects RENAME TO projects_old

CREATE TABLE projects (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    user_id     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    project_dir TEXT NOT NULL,
    agent_path  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    work_dir    TEXT NOT NULL,
    bug_dir     TEXT NOT NULL,
    guide_text  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    commit_spec TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    deploy_spec TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    env_label   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL
)

INSERT INTO projects(id, user_id, name, project_dir, agent_path, work_dir, bug_dir,
                     guide_text, commit_spec, deploy_spec, env_label, created_at)
SELECT id, user_id, name, project_dir, agent_path, work_dir, bug_dir,
       guide_text, commit_spec, deploy_spec, env_label, created_at
FROM projects_old
DROP TABLE projects_old

steps.desc: 补建用户内唯一索引 idx_projects_user_name（重建之后执行）
sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_user_name ON projects(user_id, name)

steps.desc: 工作目录化：旧 work_dir（案例库根）改存工作目录，bug_dir 列废弃置空

when.sql: SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE bug_dir != '' LIMIT 1

steps.desc: P4 排队占位单态化：blocked+queue 归位 doing+queue

when.sql: SELECT 1 FROM board_cards WHERE block_kind='queue' AND column_key='blocked' LIMIT 1

sql: UPDATE board_cards SET column_key='doing' WHERE block_kind='queue' AND column_key='blocked'

steps.desc: 飞书配置用户级化：旧全局 app_settings['feishu'] 迁给 admin 的用户级配置

when.sql: SELECT 1 FROM app_settings WHERE key='feishu' LIMIT 1

steps.desc: v3d 租约层删除：DROP 存量 leases 表与索引（幂等）
sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS leases
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_leases_project

steps.desc: v2a 状态机扩七枚举：claimed 行归一 starting

when.sql: SELECT 1 FROM wait_items WHERE state='claimed' LIMIT 1

sql: UPDATE wait_items SET state='starting' WHERE state='claimed'

steps.desc: 活跃唯一索引口径扩到四活跃态（旧库 WHERE 仍含 claimed 时重建）

when.sql: SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND name='idx_wait_active' AND coalesce(sql,'') NOT LIKE '%''starting''%' LIMIT 1

sql: DROP INDEX idx_wait_active
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_wait_active ON wait_items(kind, target_id) WHERE state IN ('waiting','starting','running','finishing')

steps.desc: 活跃唯一索引口径扩到五活跃态（含 suspended：任务等作答让出串行位时行仍活跃）

when.sql: SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND name='idx_wait_active' AND coalesce(sql,'') NOT LIKE '%suspended%' LIMIT 1

sql: DROP INDEX idx_wait_active
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_wait_active ON wait_items(kind, target_id) WHERE state IN ('waiting','starting','running','finishing','suspended')

steps.desc: M1：把 schema 版本号写入 app_settings['schema_version']（两侧对拍前置断言）
sql: INSERT INTO app_settings(key, json) VALUES('schema_version', '1') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET json=excluded.json
